errors.trigger: A JSON argument or input cannot be read, uses an unsupported carrier, is empty, has invalid syntax, or has a non-object top level.
errors.remediation: Use the parameter's declared carrier and provide readable UTF-8 content containing one JSON object. Follow the specific failure remediation.

errors.trigger: A public or private object violates its closed contract.
errors.remediation: Rebuild the object from current package schemas.

errors.trigger: Task, Git, GitHub, review, plan, or transaction identity changed.
errors.remediation: Rerun the current Branch Review and Publication preparation/readiness.

errors.trigger: Delivery PR body contains an Issue closing keyword.
errors.remediation: Use Refs only; Completion owns later closure decisions.

errors.trigger: A bound Git or GitHub mutation did not reach its exact postcondition.
errors.remediation: Resume the same transaction after the external blocker clears.

Preserve the original command, exit status, stdout and stderr; the cause of this internal failure is not established. Report it to guru-publish-task-delivery maintenance, then use this owner's original recovery after repair without repeating completed Git/GitHub mutations.

errors.trigger: The selected archived Task bytes or mode differ from the physical source supplied to this original owner.
errors.remediation: Reread the exact selected archive through the original maintenance owner; preserve its frozen source and any later work.

errors.trigger: The Task or publication transaction locator does not satisfy its existing path contract.
errors.remediation: Use the exact repository-local Task or publication transaction locator.

errors.trigger: The selected Task is not active.
errors.remediation: Return to the original Task owner and select the active Task before publication.

errors.trigger: The current Task identity, checkout binding or base is unavailable or stale.
errors.remediation: Recover the current Task identity and checkout through the original owner, then reprepare publication.

errors.trigger: The canonical repository binding cannot be resolved.
errors.remediation: Restore the canonical repository binding, then reprepare publication.

errors.trigger: The Delivery branch read did not return a valid commit identity.
errors.remediation: Reread the Delivery branch through the original publication owner before resuming.

errors.trigger: The original publication PR binding or recorded metadata no longer matches live facts.
errors.remediation: Reread the exact original PR through the publication owner before resuming the same transaction.

errors.trigger: The original publication transaction or semantic gate does not match its contract or current plan.
errors.remediation: Recover the exact original publication transaction through this owner; preserve completed external actions.

errors.trigger: The requested original publication transaction is unavailable.
errors.remediation: Recover the exact original publication transaction through this owner before retrying.
